## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED for task 1's policies, base policy, parameters or tool contracts. First revision.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict):
- The parameter meaning of `late_charge_minimum_usd` ("smallest late charge assessed") predates the minimum-combination rule, under which a charge with no other-invoice late charges carries no minimum and may be smaller; the KB carries the parameter meaning verbatim (invoicing_and_late_charge_terms). Source-faithful.
- Two figures the late-charge rule reads are product figures of sibling products (`flatfee.invoice_due_days`, `legal.cost_deposit_minimum_balance_usd`); they are stated only in docs/flatfee and docs/legal, which were published and reachable through the runtime grep at audit time. Contradictions between those corpora and this one are outside this skill's detection range; none was observed for the two figures used.
